title: Lab - KubeConfig
scenario: Read and repair kubeconfig files. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Inventory
tasks.instructions: How many clusters, users and contexts are in the default kubeconfig? Which context is current?
tasks.solution:
kubectl config view
kubectl config current-context

tasks.title: Task 2 - Another file
tasks.instructions: Using my-kube-config, switch to context research and list Pods.
tasks.solution:
kubectl config --kubeconfig=my-kube-config use-context research
kubectl --kubeconfig=my-kube-config get pods

tasks.title: Task 3 - Repair
tasks.instructions: The file points at a client certificate that does not exist. Find and fix the path.
tasks.solution:
kubectl --kubeconfig=my-kube-config get pods  # error names the file
# correct client-certificate path
